711020201.text: Welcome. One's name is Fujin, the local Adeptus, and this is the tiny little teapot realm one calls home for now.

711020202.text: Huh? We were still in the mountains just now. How did we suddenly end up...

711020203.text: One invited you to come as guests, yet failed to sufficiently explain beforehand. Such behavior was careless, and one begs for your forgiveness.

711020204.text: Uh, Paimon's just not sure this counts as an invitation, that's all... So, do you just "swoosh" all visitors to Chenyu Vale in here like this?

711020205.text: #Hehe, of course not! Many come and go from Chenyu Vale, but it was only in light of your incredible compatibility with the local spirit veins that I chose to invite the two of you, {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

711020207.text: Your names were carried here by the fish that swim. I have long anticipated your visit.

711020208.text: It is a pity that it is now not quite convenient, else I would have invited you to a tea-tasting banquet — speaking of which, I am quite sorry, but I have a request to make of you.

711020212.text: Thank you. I presume the two of you have heard of the tea village of Chenyu Vale, Qiaoying Village? This land has been famous for its cool, fragrant waters since ancient times. The people are of gentle character, and the pristine pebbles in its streams are exquisite.

711020214.text: Precisely. The waters and soil of Chenyu Vale have begun to change recently, as has the scent of its tea... Qiaoying Village will inevitably decline, should this persist.

711020215.text: One hopes that you two can resolve the disharmony of the soil and water on one's behalf. The water veins are spread across the mountains, but my power is no longer sufficient, nor is the present a good time for me to move about. Thus, I must rely on your kindness and aid.

711020216.text: #Uh, we aren't exactly experts when it comes to dealing with soil and water. Is there a problem that {NICKNAME} can just solve by resorting to gratuitous violence?

711020217.text: Hehe, just as I heard, you are quite direct. But fret not. You are clever by nature — I trust that you shall get to the heart of any problems you might encounter.

711020211.text: Hey, don't be nervous! Isn't getting dragged into adventures while passing by kind of our thing? Shouldn't we at least listen to what she has to say?

subQuests.subQuestName: Use your adeptal energy to leave the domain

711020301.text: Welcome. One's name is Fujin, the local Adeptus, and this is the tiny little teapot realm one calls home for now.

711020302.text: Huh? We were still doing the delivery just now, how did we suddenly end up...

711020303.text: I see. So the paper is used to make kites, yes? Hehe... I can feel festive fortune emanating from you. I hope that this sudden invitation will not ruin the fun.

711020304.text: Eh? Well, uh, Happy Lantern Rite! That said, Paimon's not sure this counts as an invitation... Huh. Were we the only ones brought here?

711020305.text: Yes... My apologies for worrying your friend, but only the two of you have surpassing compatibility with the local spirit veins, which is why I could only invite you in.

711020307.text: Yes, your names were carried here by the fish that swim, and I have thus long anticipated your visit.

711020308.text: It is a pity that it is now not quite convenient, else I would have invited you to a tea-tasting banquet — speaking of which, I am quite sorry, but I have a request to make of you.

711020312.text: Thank you. I presume the two of you have heard of the tea village of Chenyu Vale, Qiaoying Village? This land has been famous for its cool, fragrant waters since ancient times. The people are of gentle character, and the pristine pebbles in its streams are exquisite.

711020314.text: Precisely. The waters and soil of Chenyu Vale have begun to change recently, as has the scent of its tea... Qiaoying Village will inevitably decline, should this persist.

711020315.text: One hopes that you two can resolve the disharmony of the soil and water on one's behalf. The water veins are spread across the mountains, but my power is no longer sufficient, nor is the present a good time for me to move about. Thus, I must rely on your kindness and aid.

711020311.text: Y—Yeah... So, Adeptus Fujin, could we trouble you to be quick?

711020403.text: #Oh! Are you... {M#Young Master, are you the son of the Feiyun Commerce Guild's manager?}{F#Young Lady, are you the daughter of the Feiyun Commerce Guild's manager? Strange, all the rumors I heard spoke of a young master...}

711020408.text: #Oh my! So you aren't the Commerce Guild's {M#Young Master}{F#Young Lady}!

711020409.text: *sigh* My apologies! I was considering only your... wondrously fashionable attire, and your flying companion! Your conduct, too, was so unlike ours that I assumed that you must have come from Liyue Harbor to discuss matters with us...

711020410.text: Lu I am surnamed, and all in the village call me Grandpa Lu... *sigh* Apologize I must, recent years have not been kind, I have not even the tea to treat you two as guests... *sigh* The Adepti will certainly not be satisfied with the tea ceremony this year...

711020411.text: Huh? Uh, Grandpa Lu, the stuff right by you... Aren't those tea leaves?

711020412.text: *sigh* The quality is far too lacking. How could I possibly serve such things to my guests? Speaking honestly, we are waiting for someone from the Feiyun Commerce Guild, for we must discuss with them the tea leaf problem. They are our biggest customers, after all.

711020413.text: The crux of the matter is that this batch of tea is simply unsatisfactory, whether it be in terms of taste or quantity. This is an open secret among tea merchants. Old Luo... the Village Chief has also decided that no tea may be sold until the quality problem is solved.

711020414.text: I have heard tell that the Young Master of the Commerce Guild is exceptionally smart and skilled. If he has caught wind that this year's tea harvest was lacking in both quality and quantity, I thought, he would come in person, or if not, send someone here. So, here I wait.

711020415.text: Anyway, the problem with the tea leaves... I believe it lies with the soil.

711020417.text: Indeed. I've lived here my whole life and worked with tea since I was but a wee lad, and I can notice problems that others may miss. As I see it — and may Adeptus Fujin bless us — it must be an imbalance in our soil and water!

711020419.text: Oh? So you've also heard the tale? That's quite rare! Even among locals, few remember.

711020420.text: Many, many years ago, Qiaoying Village was nothing but a barren hill. Terrifying demons dwelt there, and it was all thanks to Adeptus Fujin that the demons were defeated, and tea trees were planted, allowing our ancestors to come live here.

711020421.text: But if it's really a problem with the water and soil, then I don't know what we can do about it...

711020407.text: #Yeah right! Don't listen to {M#his}{F#her} jokes, old man!

subQuests.subQuestName: Join the conversation between Jin and Uncle Luo

711020901.text: Would you specifically need someone from Fontaine to fix it?

711020902.text: Heh, well, whether in Liyue or Fontaine, most things powered by elemental energy work on more or less the same principles, yeah? If a Fontainian engineer can fix it, so can our thaumaturges.

711020903.text: It just so happens that this Ms. "Oat Moon-tan-yee" likes to travel around Liyue, passes through here every so often, and loves to offer her services. So as for this round of tea cauldron maintenance, well, let's leave it to her.

711020904.text: So you see, honored guests... Hehe, I'm really sorry, but I need to trouble you to go to Yilong Wharf and find our technician, Ms. Oat Moon-tan-yee. It's more likely than not she's found herself a show there that she can't tear her eyes off!

711020905.text: How could you possibly dare to ask our guests to do such a thing!?

711020906.text: Old Luo, you misunderstand me. Our honored guest already had business to attend to at Yilong Wharf, and it would just be passing along a message on their way. It's nothing, really.

711020910.text: I'm truly sorry... Then if you would, honored guests. Old Lu, I'll leave it to you to accompany them.

711020911.text: Aiya, thanks for your hard work! You scared Old Luo so much he was jumping at his own shadow, hahaha!

711020912.text: You mentioned earlier that you're here to investigate the water and soil, right? Best you head over to Yilong Wharf, then. It isn't far from the headwaters, and there are ruins left by the Adepti along the way, so if you're looking for clues, there's your best bet.

711020913.text: As for passing a message to Oat Moon-tan-yee, well, please lend a hand, would you? Give Old Luo some peace of mind, so he doesn't worry himself to death.

711020914.text: #{M#Even Mini Pie can handle a thing so trivial.}{F#Hehe, for the Young Lady, 'tis but a trifling matter.}

711020915.text: #Hey! Why're you still acting!? The show's over! {M#And what's with calling Paimon "Mini Pie" anyway!?}{F#And Paimon just realized, what's with "Mini Pie" anyway!?}

711020916.text: Anyway, just leave it to us! You can rest easy, Grandpa Lu!

711020917.text: Such great kids you are, really great kids... Oh, right! I noticed that you two really enjoyed the teacake. Why don't I teach you the recipe? Next time you come by some quality tea leaves, you'll be able to make some for yourselves.

711020918.text: In any case, safe travels! Be careful on mountain paths, and mind you don't slip!

711021501.text: #Hehe, {NICKNAME}, Paimon, you two are indeed brilliant, as expected. Upon seeing my dissipated adeptal energy, you immediately understood the situation.

711021502.text: Of course! We're super-duper experienced adventurers, you know! Still, why didn't you say anything sooner? You didn't just forget, did you?

711021504.text: Ahem! About that, should not the path of the Adepti be full of challenges? 'Tis merely a test of your wisdom!

711021507.text: Speaking of which, just what's the problem with the soil and water you mentioned before? Grandpa Lu was also sure that this was behind the deteriorating quality of the tea leaves.

711021508.text: Yes, you too have seen Qiaoying Village. Should the quality and quantity of tea leaves continue to decline, so will the village, until finally — in the years to come — it degenerates back into what it was millennia before: a desolate mountain forest.

711021801.text: #Haha, I'm the {M#young master}{F#young lady} of the Feiyun Commerce Guild.

711021802.text: #Alright, alright, that's quite enough acting! Are you alright, {NICKNAME}...?

711021803.text: #Yup, our {M#young master}{F#young lady} is... Wait, that's not right! {M#He's}{F#She's} {NICKNAME}, and Paimon's Paimon. Anyway, it was Grandpa Lu who sent us looking for you.

711021804.text: #{M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}, Ms. Paimon, hello! I'm Little Mao, a friend of Mountain's!

711021805.text: Yes, that's what my name means. Hautemontagne can be a bit hard to pronounce, so I asked Little Mao to just call me that.

711021806.text: Really...? Quite the interesting pair! How did you two meet?

711021807.text: It was quite fortuitous! Last year I went to the mountains in the south for a spell, and got lost in the fog. A huge beast the size of a "Cal. Etienne-Louis" was glaring at me, and I thought I was done for! But just then...

711021808.text: A little kid suddenly shouted at me! I followed the sound through the mist and got out, and was saved! Otherwise, I would've been eaten, just like that, and my family in Fontaine wouldn't even have been able to claim compensation on my account!

711021809.text: Heehee, I know more about what goes on in the mountains than the grown-ups!

711021810.text: Is that so? You're amazing, Little Mao!

711021813.text: Alright, got it! I'll be there in a jiffy. *sigh* All the shows here are just too good. I ended up watching several, one right after the other, and now my legs have fallen asleep. But I just can't understand a word... What sorts of stories are they telling?

711021814.text: It's about how way back when, a huge carp and a monster from the mountains fought! A "you kill me, I kill you" story. In the end, everyone dies!

711021815.text: Uh... That's a pretty concise summary! But don't talk about killing and dying so much, Little Mao! If you think about that kind of stuff too often, you might become the villain when you grow up!

711021816.text: Since those in Qiaoying Village are waiting on me, it's time to go! See you all later!

711021817.text: Let's go watch the shows here again when you're about to head back to Fontaine!

711021818.text: Okay, now that we've solved the puzzle, we can get back to business. Little Mao, how about you?

711021819.text: What are you two going to do?

711021820.text: Huh? To be honest, we're not quite sure how to explain it... The water and soil in Chenyu Vale are kinda out of whack, and we need to cure them for everything in Chenyu Vale to get better.

711021821.text: I get it! Ms. Paimon is trying to say that we need to restore nature?

711021822.text: Hey, that's right! You're really amazing, Little Mao, you got it right away!

711021823.text: "Restoring nature," you say? Did someone talk to you about that?

711021824.text: That's right — a friend who's always taking care of me told me! She wants to restore nature too. If we restore nature, everything will get better, so I want to help too. She also told me about you two!

711021825.text: Oh! So you've seen her too?

711021826.text: Huh? You mean my friend? Of course! Silly Ms. Paimon, how could we be friends if I'd never seen her?

711021827.text: Fair point! That makes things easier! Actually, we want to... Paimon remembers we need to find the jade treasures in the water, and then do some Rainjade Rite. But even though we've come upstream, we still haven't found any clues...

711021828.text: Ah! I know! Come with me, I'll show you where to look!

711021829.text: What? Is it really that easy?

711021830.text: Little Mao, your friend wants to restore nature, right?

711021831.text: Yeah! She's told me a lot, such as stories from before Qiaoying Village became Qiaoying Village, how the tea trees came to be, and more. She said that things will get worse and worse in Chenyu Vale if the natural order isn't restored.

711021832.text: Oh! Looks like we're on the same page then.

711021833.text: Little Mao, you just said you knew where we could find leads, right?

711021834.text: Yeah... I don't know if it'll help, but when you mentioned "jade treasures" and "Rainjade" and stuff, I just thought of it! Come with me!

711020801.text: Uncle Luo, this batch still isn't any good! They're not fragrant enough when you dry them, and they get so dry and brittle that you can't even put them in the roller... Even the ones that survive the secondary processes come out the other end a complete disaster...

711020802.text: ...Are you sure it isn't a problem with the machine? Are you sure you haven't forgotten how to operate it?

711020803.text: ...What a thing to say. How could we dare to be careless, with you looking over our shoulders?

711020805.text: #Aiya, it's Grandpa Lu! Jin, get back to work... And this respectable-looking young {M#man}{F#miss} is...?

711020807.text: #(Hey! Just who the heck calls themselves {M#Young Master}{F#Young Lady}!?)

711020811.text: This is my servant. It will suffice to call her "Mini Pie."

711020812.text: Uh... Hahaha! Yes, that's it! Call me Mini Pie!

711020813.text: Oh! In that case, welcome, welcome! A guest like you is a rare treat indeed. We have been quite reliant on the assistance of the Commerce Guild for many a year. But as for what's happened this year... I suspect you have already heard about it...

711020814.text: What's wrong? You're looking pretty miserable, did Jin mess up at work again?

711020815.text: Hmph! You old... mocking me again! *ahem* My apologies, dear guests. Normally I would invite guests from afar to sample our new teas, but this year's batch... *sigh* Well, you know.

711020809.text: What the heck? And you even proclaim yourself a member of the Guhua Clan...

711020810.text: #Ahem! This is the {M#Young Master}{F#Young Lady} of the Feiyun Commerce Guild. Uh, {M#he}{F#she} really likes reading Wandering Hero novels for fun... and, uhm, the landscape of Chenyu Vale is filled with a mysterious... mystique! It must've gone to {M#his}{F#her} head...

711021003.text: A whole lot of our tea is also transported through there. *sigh* Though this batch of tea leaves isn't any good, and until we figure out why and solve the problem, we won't sell anything to outsiders. The last thing we want to do is ruin Qiaoying Village's good name.

711022013.text: Alright, got it! I'll be there in a jiffy. *sigh* All the shows here are just too good. I ended up watching several, one right after the other, and now my legs have fallen asleep. But I just can't understand a word... What sorts of stories are they telling?

711022014.text: It's about how way back when, a huge carp and a monster from the mountains fought! A "you kill me, I kill you" story. In the end, everyone dies!

711022015.text: Uh... That's a pretty concise summary! But don't talk about killing and dying so much, Little Mao! If you think about that kind of stuff too often, you might become the villain when you grow up!

711022016.text: Since those in Qiaoying Village are waiting on me, it's time to go! See you all later!

711022017.text: Let's go watch the shows here again when you're about to head back to Fontaine!

711022018.text: Okay, now that we've solved the puzzle, we can get back to business. Little Mao, how about you?

711022019.text: What are you two going to do?

711022020.text: Huh? To be honest, we're not quite sure how to explain it... The water and soil in Chenyu Vale are kinda out of whack, and we need to cure them for everything in Chenyu Vale to get better.

711022021.text: I get it! Ms. Paimon is trying to say that we need to restore nature?

711022022.text: Hey, that's right! You're really amazing, Little Mao, you got it right away!

711022023.text: "Restoring nature," you say? Did someone talk to you about that?

711022024.text: That's right — a friend who's always taking care of me told me! She wants to restore nature too. If we restore nature, everything will get better, so I want to help too. She also told me about you two!

711022025.text: Oh! So you've seen her too?

711022026.text: Huh? You mean my friend? Of course! Silly Ms. Paimon, how could we be friends if I'd never seen her?

711022027.text: Fair point! That makes things easier! Actually, we want to... Paimon remembers we need to find the jade treasures in the water, and then do some Rainjade Rite. But even though we've come upstream, we still haven't found any clues...

711022028.text: Ah! I know! Come with me, I'll show you where to look!

711022029.text: What? Is it really that easy?

711022030.text: Little Mao, your friend wants to restore nature, right?

711022031.text: Yeah! She's told me a lot, such as stories from before Qiaoying Village became Qiaoying Village, how the tea trees came to be, and more. She said that things will get worse and worse in Chenyu Vale if the natural order isn't restored.

711022032.text: Oh! Looks like we're on the same page then.

711022033.text: Little Mao, you just said you knew where we could find leads, right?

711022034.text: Yeah... I don't know if it'll help, but when you mentioned "jade treasures" and "Rainjade" and stuff, I just thought of it! Come with me!

711023001.text: By the way, Paimon's not sure if this is an appropriate thing to say but... your aura seems a bit different from that of the other adepti we've met somehow...

711023002.text: Hehe, my friends have said similar things before. But surely it's only natural that each individual pers— *cough* I mean, adeptus has an "aura" of their own?

711023003.text: Your friends, huh... Ooh, they must also be formidable adepti, like Moon Carver or Mountain Shaper!

711023005.text: ...Yes, that's exactly how it is. It's just that... those two friends are probably busy taking care of their own affairs right now. That is why one must leave this business of nursing the water and soil to the two of you instead.

711023006.text: Uhh, still not sure what exactly it is we're meant to do, but, uh... we'll go take a look, anyway!

711029902.text: Ah, I forgot something important! If you see a golden... Can you hear me...

711029903.text: Paimon doesn't think we'll get far investigating the water and soil here. Let's head to Qiaoying Village first, shall we?

711029904.text: If we've time on the road, we can try the "power" of that Adeptus Fujin!

711029905.text: Ah...? Youngsters, over here, over here!
